name: Balanced Opening Position (Italian Game)
description: Standard symmetrical Italian Game position with equal material (0 cp difference) and balanced positional development.

name: Material Advantage (White +Rook)
description: White enjoys a significant material advantage (+500 cp) having captured a black rook while retaining active minor pieces.

name: Material Disadvantage (White -Bishop)
description: White is down a minor piece (Bishop, -330 cp) and must coordinate active play to compensate for the material deficit.

name: Tactical Capture Opportunity (Knight Fork)
description: Tactical tension where captures on d5 or c4 create concrete tactical outcomes and piece trades.

name: King Safety Vulnerability (Exposed Black King)
description: Both kings have castled, but sharp lines involving Bg5, h3, and Nd5 test king safety and pawn shelter defenses.

name: Forced Checkmate Opportunity (Mate-in-2)
description: Classic Scholar's mate pattern where White has an immediate winning attack Qxf7# or decisive offensive follow-ups.

name: Defensive Resiliency (Countering Bishop Pin)
description: Black's bishop on b4 is attacked by White's pawn c3; Black must defend or retreat effectively to maintain structural harmony.

name: Tactical Poisoned Pawn (Greedy Failure Trap)
category: Tactical position where greedy evaluation may fail
description: Greedy 1-ply search may favor snatching an immediate central pawn or piece without accounting for opponent's pin/fork rebuttal.

name: Endgame Pawn Breakthrough
description: Deep endgame pawn structure requiring precise calculation of king opposition and passed pawn potential.

name: Complex Middlegame (Sicilian Defense)
description: Rich tactical and strategic middlegame with open c-file, central knight outpost, and mutual attacking chances.
